storybook_2_5d.description: Layered vector storybook scenes with restrained parallax, painted-color feel and simple illustrated characters.

documentary_infographic.description: High-contrast data cards, timelines, maps as simplified vector geometry and clean labels.
documentary_infographic.notes: Use primary sources for numbers and dates.

paper_cut.description: Layered cut-paper shapes, offset shadows and limited colour palette.
paper_cut.notes: Use original illustrations and avoid copying existing character designs.

kinetic_type.description: Typographic motion, large words, symbolic shapes and strict safe-area control.
kinetic_type.notes: Current renderer supports text elements but not word-by-word karaoke alignment.
